## Setup

We will be using the `g++` compiler throughout.

<pre><code class="language-c++">#include <iostream>

int main() {
    std::cout << "Hello world!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>

To compile:

<pre><code class="language-bash">> g++ hello.cc -o hello
</code></pre>
